knowledge._note: runtime-fetch is the default until legal approval covers redistributing extracted API surface (spec §17 Q0 / §18). bundled commits knowledge/imports/.

ios._chatPackaging: iOS prefers SPM. The v4 chat repo (sendbird-chat-sdk-ios) ships Package.swift; add it via SPM (product SendbirdChatSDK, from 4.0.0). Do NOT use sendbird-chat-ios-spm — that mirror is LEGACY v3 (SendBirdSDK). Use CocoaPods only if the project already has a Podfile; never introduce one.

repos._note: Public mirror repos only. Non-public sources never appear here.

productScope._note: The default scope is every product in .products except notYetSupported. `focus` marks where verification depth is highest. A customer narrows scope with SENDBIRD_PRODUCTS or .sendbird-client/profile.json enabledProducts. A notYetSupported product is never in scope: resolve-products.sh drops it from SENDBIRD_PRODUCTS or the profile, --check reports it as not supported yet, and the welcome hook tells the model to decline it. Its knowledge and templates stay shipped, so removing it from notYetSupported turns it back on.
